title: Ensure all checks have passed before merging new code
description: A pipeline that runs but cannot block a merge is decoration. Tests, linters and security scans only reduce risk if a red result stops the pull request. A path-filtered build or a conditional status check gates only some pull requests, so it does not meet this control on its own.
remediation: Project settings -> Repositories -> <repository> -> Policies -> Branch Policies -> <default branch> -> Build validation -> +: add the CI pipeline with Policy requirement Required and no path filter. A Status check (Status checks -> +) that is Required, set to "Apply by default" and not path-filtered also counts. To cover every repository, add the build validation on the project-wide policy at Project settings -> Repositories -> All Repositories -> Policies -> Branch Policies.
fixSummary: Add a required, unfiltered build at Project settings -> Repositories -> <repo> -> Policies.
